Meta Platforms antitrust OR monopoly investigation 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 披露：FTC 自 2020 年起訴 Meta 反壟斷，訴求含剝離或重組 Instagram 與 WhatsApp；2024 年 11 月歐盟執委會就 Marketplace 搭售與資料使用開罰。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Beginning in 2020, we became subject to a lawsuit by the FTC alleging that we violated antitrust laws, including by acquiring Instagram in 2012 and WhatsApp in 2014. The complaint seeks a permanent injunction against our company's alleged violations of the antitrust laws, and other equitable relief, including divestiture or reconstruction of Instagram and WhatsApp. In addition, in November 2024, the European Commission issued a fine as a result of its finding that we tied Facebook Marketplace to Facebook and use data in a manner that infringes European Union competition rules.

findings.claim: 10-K 披露：美國、歐洲及其他轄區競爭主管機關對 Meta 的社交、廣告、行動應用及併購行為有多項訴訟與調查，且數量與重要性近年增加。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: Over the last several years, the number and potential significance of the litigation and investigations involving the company have increased, and there can be no assurance that this trend will not continue.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋摘要（非逐字）顯示：聯邦法院 2025-11 判 FTC 敗訴（未證明 Meta 現有壟斷力），FTC 2026-01 提上訴至 D.C. 巡迴法院；歐盟 DMA 2025-04 罰 €200m，並曾考慮 WhatsApp AI 臨時措施；英國 £3.1bn 集體訴訟。以上未取得可逐字原文，僅以 clues 列出。未查 DOJ 專項。
